other_conditions: Applicant must be the spouse of the deceased worker or one of the living parents
The deceased worker must have been suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana
The death of the worker must have been due to silicosis
The deceased worker must have been employed in a factory or at a construction site
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,500 per month is provided to the spouse of a deceased worker, or to the worker’s living parents if the worker was unmarried.
documents_required: certificate of being the widow/widower or nominee
